items.title: Price increase for tariff "Funkwelle Flex 30" takes effect
items.quote: zum 01.06.2026 erhöhen wir den monatlichen Grundpreis Ihres Tarifs „Funkwelle Flex 30“ von 24,99 € auf 27,99 €.
items.computation: The letter states the new price applies from a fixed calendar date, 01.06.2026. This date is used as printed; no counting needed.

items.title: Exercise special termination right (Sonderkündigungsrecht) due to the price increase
items.quote: Dieses Recht können Sie innerhalb von drei Monaten ausüben, nachdem Ihnen diese Mitteilung zugegangen ist; der Vertrag endet dann frühestens mit dem Tag, an dem die Preiserhöhung wirksam wird.
items.computation: The letter is a private (non-authority) notice, so no statutory Bekanntgabefiktion applies; the 3-month period under § 57 Abs. 1 TKG runs from actual receipt (Zugang), which is not separately stated. As the earliest plausible reading, the receipt date is taken to be the letter's own date, 13.04.2026 (Monday) — a letter cannot be received before it is dated, so this is the earliest possible start and yields the earliest (safest) deadline. Under §§ 187 Abs. 1, 188 Abs. 2 BGB, the day of receipt is not counted and the 3-month period ends on the day with the same calendar number 3 months later: 13.04. + 3 months = 13.07.2026. 13.07.2026 is a Monday and not a public holiday in NW, so no weekend/holiday shift under § 193 BGB is needed. The actual (unknown) later receipt date would only push this deadline further out, never earlier.

warnings: The letter does not state a separate posting/dispatch date distinct from the letter date (13.04.2026); as this is a private company (not subject to the statutory Zugangsfiktion for authorities), the exact date of actual receipt (Zugang) that starts the 3-month special-termination period is unknown. The due date 2026-07-13 was computed using the letter date itself as the earliest plausible receipt date, which is a conservative (safe-side) assumption — the true deadline could be a few days later if the letter arrived after 13.04.2026, so the recipient should confirm the actual delivery date and, if in doubt, act well before 2026-07-13.
